notes.feedback_no_gaode_for_content.md: File does not exist on disk. Listed as changed but confirmed absent. Likely deleted/superseded by policy_content_source.md. No audit findings possible; flagged as informational.
notes.memory_files_scope: Memory files (.claude/projects/*/memory/*.md) are user-authored preference/feedback files, not command/agent/script files. Standards 1, 2, 3, 7, 9, 10 do not apply to them. Standards 4, 5, 6, 8, 11 applied where relevant.

violations.finding: YAML frontmatter description field contains Chinese: '文艺温馨'. This is in a machine-parsed frontmatter field (description:), not a user-facing documentation paragraph.
violations.recommendation: Use English in frontmatter: description: 'User\'s girlfriend Jade is INFJ - prefers artsy, cozy, literary spots. Applies only on couple trips.'

violations.finding: Inline Chinese in rule text: '文艺温馨 (artsy, cozy, literary aesthetic)' and '精品民宿' on line 10, '情侣时间' on line 13. These are inside preference rules that agents must parse and act on.
violations.recommendation: Per standard 6 exemption for verbatim user-binding quotes: if these Chinese terms are verbatim user phrases used as search/matching keys for rednote/gaode, they are permissible only if (a) the English gloss immediately follows in parentheses AND (b) the surrounding rule text is English. Lines 9-10 already satisfy this (gloss present). Line 13 '情侣时间' has no English equivalent in the same line — add gloss: '(couple time)'.

violations.finding: Section header '## 中国大陆行程 (China Mainland Trips)' uses Chinese as the primary heading text. Line 12: '小红书 (rednote)', line 13: '高德 (gaode)', line 14: '绝不 fallback 到 POI 搜索', line 16: '## 国际行程 (International Trips)', line 23: '小红书-verified'.
violations.recommendation: Section headings must be English-primary. Use '## China Mainland Trips' and '## International Trips'. For inline Chinese technical terms like '小红书' and '高德', the pattern 'rednote (小红书)' or 'gaode (高德)' is acceptable as those are proper names used as search keys. However, '绝不 fallback 到 POI 搜索' on line 14 is a Chinese sentence fragment in a rule — translate entirely to English: 'never fall back to gaode POI search or any other substitute source'.

violations.finding: Entry for user_jade_infj.md in MEMORY.md contains Chinese: '文艺温馨 spots'. Memory index entries are parsed by agents and must be English.
violations.recommendation: Change to: '— Jade is INFJ, artsy/cozy/literary spots (couple trips only — does not apply when Jade is not traveling)'

violations.finding: Line 27 contains '高德' as a literal token in rule text describing what is blocked. While this appears in a deny-list documentation context, the surrounding rule is an agent instruction file and must be English.
violations.recommendation: Rewrite as: 'Any literal token matching gaode-maps, gaode_maps, amap, or the Chinese name for Gaode (高德) in a Bash command'. The Chinese character is used here as a search-key token the hook must detect — this is a valid technical exception analogous to the verbatim-quote exemption. No change required; documenting as advisory finding only.

violations.finding: Line 53: '文艺温馨 / boutique / non-chain hotels', line 54: '五道口' used as a proper-noun location key inside a hard filter rule. These are Chinese characters in agent instruction text.
violations.recommendation: Line 53: '文艺温馨' already has an established English gloss ('artsy, cozy, literary') — acceptable as verbatim user-binding key if gloss is present; add gloss inline: 'artsy/cozy/literary (文艺温馨)'. Line 54: '五道口' is a proper place name (Wudaokou subway station); acceptable as a proper noun search key with pinyin adjacent: 'Wudaokou (五道口)' — already acceptable as written since 'Wudaokou' precedes it.

violations.finding: The 'WRITE TOOL ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN' block (28 lines) duplicates constraint enforcement that is already handled by the harness hook and the DO NOT section at the top of the file. It includes a 'Violation consequences' subsection with threats ('You will be immediately terminated and replaced') that are non-functional narrative. The 'Self-verification before EVERY tool call' box at lines 83-87 is then repeated verbatim as a full section at lines 648-680 (the 'Self-Verification Checkpoints' section).
violations.recommendation: Collapse the inline block at lines 62-89 to: 'Write and Edit tools are disabled for this agent (hook-enforced). Use scripts/save.py for all data writes — see Step 3.' Remove the redundant inline self-verification box; the dedicated section at line 648 is sufficient.

violations.finding: The 'JSON I/O Best Practices (REQUIRED)' section (lines 369-390) entirely repeats the save.py usage patterns already shown in Step 3 (lines 339-347) and again in the 'Unified Data Access Scripts' section (lines 532-586). save.py is documented three separate times with near-identical bash usage examples.
violations.recommendation: Remove the 'JSON I/O Best Practices' section entirely. Its content is fully covered by Step 3 and the Unified Data Access Scripts section. The 685-line file could be reduced by ~20 lines without losing any information.

violations.finding: Line 237 in the 'search_results field' documentation lists 'gaode-maps' as a common skill: 'Common skills: google-maps, gaode-maps, airbnb'. This directly contradicts the DO NOT section at the top of this same file, which states gaode-maps is on the deny list and will be rejected by the hook. Listing it as a 'common skill' is misleading documentation.
violations.recommendation: Remove 'gaode-maps' from the common skills list on line 237. Replace with: 'Common skills: google-maps, airbnb (China: rednote — gaode-maps forbidden for this agent)'.

violations.finding: Hardcoded specific dates: '2026-05-06', '2026-05-09', '2026-05-11', '2026-05-12' for Beijing class-day proximity rule. These dates are trip-specific and will become stale or incorrect for any other trip.
violations.recommendation: This rule belongs in the trip's requirements-skeleton.json or a trip-specific config, not hard-coded in the agent file. The agent should read class_days from the trip metadata. Remove the hardcoded dates and replace with: 'If the trip requirements specify class_days for Beijing, apply Wudaokou-proximate hard filter on those days. Read class_days from requirements-skeleton.json.'

violations.finding: Line 14 contains a Chinese sentence used as a rule: '绝不 fallback 到 POI 搜索'. This is inside an English-language rule document and is not a verbatim user-binding quote — it is a directive to agents.
violations.recommendation: Translate entirely: 'never fall back to gaode POI search or any other substitute source'. The parenthetical Chinese on the same line is redundant once the English rule is clear.
